newsitem.title: USA: Puget, Wash. Energy merger finding seen Wed.
newsitem.headline: Puget, Wash. Energy merger finding seen Wed.

text.p: The Washington Utilities and Transportation Commission advised Puget Sound Power & Light Co and Washington Energy Co that it will issue a decision on their proposed merger next Wednesday.

The companies boards of directors have scheduled separate but concurrent meetings on Feb 7 to review the commission's order and, if terms are acceptable, could give final approval to merge into a new company to be called Puget Sound Energy.
If approved by both boards, the effective time of the merger would be the close of trading on Feb 10.
The following day, Puget Sound Energy shares would begin trading on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol, PSD.
